title: Whoop plans
description: A black band with a big light heading over membership cards: each a 24px-rounded card washed in its own pastel gradient (silver, sky blue, mauve-cream-mint) with a spaced capital plan name, a centred line, a product shot, a translucent price panel with a struck-through old price and a monthly-payment chip, a navy perk strip, a check-list and black buy and outline buttons. On phones the cards snap in a centred track starting on the middle one with both neighbours peeking; on desktop they sit side by side.
notes: the band is black in light mode and the card colour in dark mode; the plan cards keep dark text on their pastels
the perk strip uses the secondary colour (navy in the whoop theme) with its foreground
